name: Martyrdom
text: [Reaction] A fighter can make this reaction when they suffer enough damage to take them out of action, but before removing them from the battlefield. Add 1 Wyrd Dice to your saved Wyrd Dice. If this fighter has the HERO keyword, add 2 instead. If this fighter has the LEADER keyword, add 3 instead.

name: Sigmar's Blessing
text: [Trait] This fighter may call for one of Sigmar's Blessings by spending saved Wyrd Dice: Hearts of Steel: When a fighter is asked to take a Bravery test, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to automatically pass the test. Righteous Fury: During this fighter's activation, after making a hit roll, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to turn a hit into a critical hit. Sigmar Protects: During an enemy fighter's activation, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to perform a reaction with this fighter without needing or spending an action to do so.
